headlines.description: — The chants started raining down in the fourth quarter. “We want Boston,” the Miami Heat crowd kept shouting, over and over.
headlines.shortLinkText: The Heat are headed to Boston after ousting the Bulls 112-91 in East play-in finale

events.name: Sacramento Kings at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Hustle plays and production from up and down the lineup helped the New Orleans Pelicans overcome the absence of leading-scorer Zion Williamson, keep their season alive and avoid a historically significant loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ingram, Valanciunas lift Zion-less Pelicans past Kings and into the playoffs
